text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf gears herself up for<n>the Satsuki
Sho, but it weighs on her<n>mind that the rest of the
student<n>council had kept the general<n>manager's
doubts a secret from her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she steps onto the track, she<n>resolves to aim
for absolute<n>perfection. If she can always be her
best self, nobody will hesitate to rely<n>on her again.
